theorems.name: Submission.codim1_hcp_lsa_mollify_lipschitz_compact_support
theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (g : Euclid m → ℝ) (K : NNReal) (S : Set (Euclid m)) (δ : ℝ), LipschitzWith K g → IsCompact S → (∀ a, a ∉ S → g a = 0) → 0 < δ → ∃ gs : ℕ → Euclid m → ℝ, (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (gs k)) ∧ (∀ k a, a ∉ Metric.cthickening δ S → gs k a = 0) ∧ TendstoUniformly gs g atTop ∧ Tendsto (fun k => ∫⁻ a, ENNReal.ofReal (‖fderiv ℝ (gs k) a - fderiv ℝ g a‖ ^ 2)) atTop (𝓝 0)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
